resources.name: Scorpion v1.2b
resources.currentCompatibility: Source title lists GTA V 1.00, 1.38, 1.43, 1.46 and “148”; the last label is preserved as supplied.

items.title: Choose the matching game build
items.text: Choose the ScorpionMenu-v1.2b-1xx.prx file matching your installed GTA V update. The source example uses ScorpionMenu-v1.2b-146.prx for GTA V 1.46. The archive includes labelled 100 EU, 100 US, 138, 143, 146, 148, 149 and 150 variants.

items.title: Transfer the plugin and data folder
items.text: Copy the selected PRX to /data/GoldHEN/plugins and the Scorpion folder to /data.

items.title: Merge the matching configuration
items.text: Edit your existing /data/GoldHEN/plugins.ini. Use your installed CUSA section and replace the example’s 150 filename with the exact selected build.

items.title: Start the game
items.text: Launch GTA V after installing the matching files.

Outfit XML Files: Self Options > Appearance > Outfit XML Files.
Choose File and enter a name without .xml, then Dump Current Outfit to XML.
FTP files from /data/Expulsion/outfits to back them up or share them.
Put custom Expulsion XML v1 files in this folder. Choose the same filename, then Import Outfit XML.
Existing exports are not overwritten: choose another name.
Imports require the same character model and valid component/prop variations. Undo restores the previous clothing/accessories.
This format stores model hash, 12 clothing components (drawable, texture, palette), and 8 accessory props. It does not store face blend, hair tint, tattoos, weapons or GTA saved-outfit-slot metadata.
Menyoo and other XML schemas are not supported by this importer.
Reserved folder. No active .osc/.csc script loader uses this folder yet.

documentation.text:
## Installation

1. Transfer **Oxagon_xxx.prx** to /data/GoldHEN/plugins using an FTP client (e.g. **FileZilla**).

2. Transfer the **Oxagon** folder to the /data directory.

3. Rename Oxagon_xxx.prx by replacing xxx with your game's title update version:

   * 153 for GTA V 1.53
   * 156 for GTA V 1.56

4. Open plugins.ini and add the appropriate entry for your game version:

[CUSA00419]
/data/GoldHEN/plugins/Oxagon_153.prx

[CUSA00411]
/data/GoldHEN/plugins/Oxagon_156.prx

resources.currentCompatibility: PS4 · GTA V 1.57 · CUSA00419 (supplied configuration). GoldHEN plugin setup.

existingGuideBlocks.title: Choose the package
existingGuideBlocks.text: Use the full package for the supplied data folder, scripts and outfits. Crystalis.sprx alone does not include those resources. 1.57 is the GTA V game update, not a menu release or console firmware version.

items.title: Check the installed game
items.text: The archive and module name GTA V 1.57. The example configuration names CUSA00419; other regional title IDs and PS5 support are not established.

items.title: Keep the data folder
items.text: Extract the original archive on your computer. Its installation note places the Crystalis folder under /data, giving /data/Crystalis. Preserve scripts, outfits and imgs. The note says img, but the actual archive and module both use /data/Crystalis/imgs/icon.png.

items.title: Place the module
items.text: The supplied note places Crystalis.sprx in /data/GoldHEN/plugins/. Use a GoldHEN plugin environment compatible with your existing PS4 firmware. This SPRX is a game plugin, not a standalone BIN/ELF payload.

items.title: Merge your configuration
items.text: Back up your existing plugins.ini. Merge the Crystalis path into the matching CUSA00419 section instead of replacing the whole file. The supplied example also lists LSOPlugin.prx, which is not included; its necessity is not documented. Preserve your unrelated plugin entries.

documentation.text:
EXPULSION CUSTOM BACKGROUND

Copy this folder to /data/Expulsion/Custom-Background on the PS4.
Open Settings > Menu Settings > Custom Background.
Enable the background, select LushModz.bg157, and Save Background Settings.
Opacity, darkening and contain/cover/stretch fit are adjustable.
Refresh Images reloads the selected image and rescans up to 32 prepared files.
The image fills the menu option area across the new and legacy designs.
Player panels retain their matching theme and colors.

This renderer uses a coarse, bounded approximation of your image made from
at most 256 colored rectangles, plus a darkening overlay. It does not load
JPG/PNG textures directly. The original LushModz.jpg is included unchanged;
LushModz-preview.png shows the prepared image detail before in-game blending.
Appearance and frame-time cost still require testing on the PS4.

To prepare another image on a computer with Python:
  python prepare_custom_background.py input.jpg MyImage.bg157 --preview preview.png
On Windows the converter uses System.Drawing if Pillow is unavailable.
On other platforms install Pillow first. Copy the resulting .bg157 file into
this folder, then use Refresh Images and select it in the menu.
Use simple logos or bold shapes for the clearest result at this drawing budget.
Files must have a lowercase .bg157 extension. Invalid files are rejected.
Save Background Settings stores both the selected filename and menu controls.

﻿EXPULSION LUA SCRIPTS - PS4 GTA 1.57

Install the updated LushModz-Expulsion-1.57.prx with GTA fully closed.
Copy MountMod.lua to:
/data/Expulsion/LUA-Scripts/MountMod.lua

In Expulsion:
Misc Options > LUA Scripts > Refresh / Search for .lua Scripts
Select MountMod.lua > Enable Script, then close Expulsion.

MountMod controls:
R1 + D-pad Down: show/hide MountMod menu.
D-pad Up/Down: select Cow, Deer or Mountain Lion.
X: activate selected option (spawns animal and mounts it).
Circle: hide MountMod menu.
While riding: left stick moves, hold X runs, Triangle dismounts/removes animal.
Stop the script from Expulsion to remove its animal and detach the rider.

The port rides animals spawned by this script; it does not mount nearby players.
The original keyboard GUI and indefinite wait loops are replaced by the PS4 API
and Expulsion's asynchronous animal-riding backend. MountMod by Ideo; PS4 port
for Expulsion. Original files retained under research/mountmod/original.

Browser:
Refresh rescans the folder. Running Scripts lists enabled scripts with Stop.
Each script has Enable, Reload and Stop. Maximum four active scripts.
Only .lua text files directly inside this folder are scanned; subfolders skipped.
File limit 64 KiB, 128 listed files, 2 MiB Lua memory per script.
Scripts start only when you enable them; no automatic startup.
Errors and instruction/memory budget failures stop the script and clean up its
owned animal. Existing native animal rides are not owned by the Lua script.

Compatibility:
This is embedded Lua 5.4.8 with Expulsion Lua API v1, not the old PC Lua plugin.
Other PC scripts must be ported; GAMEPLAY/AI/UI/Libs/Keys/wait are not provided.
A script returns a table with optional init(), tick(), stop() functions.
See API.md for the supported functions. Arbitrary native pointers are not exposed.

Local runtime, browser, controller and cleanup tests passed. Real PS4 behavior
has not been verified. Keep LUA-LICENSE.txt with redistributed builds.

LUSH MODZ FUN V1 MENU
Copy LushModzFunV1Menu.lua into the same LUA-Scripts folder. Requires the
updated PRX bundled with this release (rect/icon/fun Lua API extensions).
Enable it from Misc Options > LUA Scripts and close the main Expulsion menu.
L1 + D-pad Down: show/hide. Up/Down: select. X: activate. Circle: back/hide.
Left/Right: adjust. Square: cycle six palettes. Triangle: cycle three designs.
Includes Self Playground, Vehicle Arcade, World Mood, Animal Rides and
Design Studio. Appearance settings last until the script is reloaded.
Vehicle actions require the driver seat and network control. Launch/boost
power is adjustable. Weather/time are local requests; session scripts may
restore them. Hiding the menu does not stop a ride; Triangle dismounts.
Stopping/reloading the script removes only the animal ride it owns.
One-shot changes such as paint, clothing, time and weather remain applied.
Avoid operating multiple Lua menus at once because controller inputs are shared.
Expulsion saves Expulsion_Map.txt here. Keep existing maps when updating.

Expulsion Indoor Skatepark
Copy indoor-skatepark.map157 into /data/Expulsion/Maps/ on PS4.
Use Map Mods > Modded Maps from PC > Indoor Skatepark.
Mansion, Military Sea Base and SidehouseX have been removed. Their old files on PS4 are no longer used.
Rebuild the retained file: python tools/convert_pc_maps157.py
Generated stunt maps remain built in.

EXPULSION V7.0 - By Lush Modz
GTA V PS4 update 1.57 - All-in-one USA / EUR PRX

PS4 INSTALL
1. Fully close GTA V. Enable GoldHEN FTP and game plugins on the PS4.
2. Extract the ZIP and open Expulsion V7.0/PS4/.
   Merge PS4/data/ into console /data/ and PS4/user/ into console /user/.
   Preserve existing settings, outfits and custom files; skip conflicting samples.
3. Install the single shared menu file at:
   /data/GoldHEN/plugins/LushModz-Expulsion-1.57.prx
   This same PRX is used for both USA and EUR. No region-specific copy is needed.
4. Edit /data/GoldHEN/plugins.ini (the filename is plugins.ini).
   Add the entry matching your installed game's title ID:

   USA - CUSA00419:
   [CUSA00419]
   /data/GoldHEN/plugins/LushModz-Expulsion-1.57.prx

   EUR - CUSA00411:
   [CUSA00411]
   /data/GoldHEN/plugins/LushModz-Expulsion-1.57.prx

   You can keep only your game's entry, or keep both entries above.
   At least the MATCHING title section and PRX path must be present.
   A USA-only entry will not load the EUR game, or vice versa.
   Use the game's title ID, not your PSN account region.
   Both sections point to the same file; you only update that one PRX.

   If your title section already exists, update its Expulsion entry instead
   of duplicating the section. Replace any old region-folder or alias path.
   Enable only one Expulsion entry per title. Preserve unrelated settings.
   plugins.ini.example is a reference, not a replacement configuration.
   If using the supported Velora build, keep Velora before Expulsion.
5. Launch GTA V again. Default menu combo: Square + D-pad Right.
   D-pad navigates, X selects, Circle returns. Saved custom binds take precedence.

INDOOR SKATEPARK
Keep /data/Expulsion/Maps/indoor-skatepark.map157 installed from this package.

IF THE MENU DOES NOT LOAD
Check update 1.57, the matching CUSA section, the exact PRX path and GoldHEN
plugin enablement. Remove duplicate Expulsion entries for the same title.
A hook/signature rejection means the executable failed compatibility checks;
do not disable those checks. EUR console testing remains required.

INCLUDED CONTENT
- Latest built LushModz-Expulsion-1.57.prx, with embedded Lua runtime.
- 92 .LushModzOutfit files: 52 male / 40 female Amethyst presets.
- 17 .LushModzOutfitNAME files: original sample plus 16 added names.
- MountMod.lua, LushModzFunV1Menu.lua, Lua API guide and Lua license.
- Existing map/UGC samples.
- Full V7.0 changelog, conversion notes.

PS4 CONTENT PATHS AND MENUS
/data/Expulsion/outfits/
  Refresh View Saved Outfit Files for portable files.
  Built-in: Outfit Options > Amethyst Outfits > Male Outfits / Female Outfits.
  Male stays first; Female is second. Use the matching freemode character.
/data/Expulsion/outfit-names/
  Outfit Options > Outfit Name Options > your actual saved wardrobe slot >
  Outfit Name Editor > Choose Premade Name File. Refresh, highlight a file
  to preview, open it, then select a name to rename only that slot.
  Undo remains available. Outfit names are limited to 31 bytes, including formatting codes.
/data/Expulsion/LUA-Scripts/
  Misc Options > LUA Scripts > Refresh > MountMod.lua > Enable Script.
  Close Expulsion, then R1 + D-pad Down shows/hides MountMod.
  D-pad chooses, X activates, Circle hides. Riding: left stick moves,
  hold X runs, Triangle dismounts. Scripts are enabled manually.
  LushModzFunV1Menu.lua: enable, close Expulsion, then L1 + D-pad Down.
  PC Lua scripts need adaptation to Expulsion Lua API v1.
/user/data/Expulsion/icons/
  Legacy assets; custom popup icons are disabled.

VERIFICATION STATUS
PRX build and focused local tests passed. Packaging is verified against
source files and the current PRX hash. PS4 appearance, Lua runtime behavior,
wardrobe rendering and saved-name persistence require console verification.
No files were uploaded to your console while creating this package.

PS4 POPUP ICONS
This build uses built-in PS4 notification icons. Custom popup logo images
are disabled; no separate logo installation is needed.

## Installation

1. Transfer **OxagonLite_xxx.prx** to /data/GoldHEN/plugins using an FTP client (e.g. **FileZilla**).

2. Transfer the **Oxagon** folder and **Oxagon.key** to the /data directory.

3. Rename OxagonLite_xxx.prx by replacing xxx with your game's title update version:

   * 153 for GTA V 1.53
   * 156 for GTA V 1.56

4. Open plugins.ini and add the appropriate entry for your game version:

[CUSA00419]
/data/GoldHEN/plugins/OxagonLite_153.prx

[CUSA00411]
/data/GoldHEN/plugins/OxagonLite_156.prx
